                                                 \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                                        \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\\n\", __FILE__, __LINE__,              \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_));                                            \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                                 \\\n        }                                                                                 \\\n    } while (0)\n\nvoid randomizeBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    for (auto& body : bodies) {\n        body.pos.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Force phase for the locally owned bodies [firstBody, firstBody + count).\n// Each thread owns one body and accumulates over all j in ascending order,\n// exactly as the serial reference does, so results are bit-identical.\n// Tiles of positions are staged in shared memory to reuse each load across the block.\n__global__ void computeForcesKernel(const double* __restrict__ pos, double* __restrict__ vel,\n                                    const int n, const int firstBody, const int count) {\n    __shared__ double tileX[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ double tileY[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ double tileZ[BLOCK_SIZE];\n\n    const int local = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const bool active = local < count;\n\n    double xi = 0.0, yi = 0.0, zi = 0.0;\n    if (active) {\n        const int i = firstBody + local;\n        xi = pos[3 * i + 0];\n        yi = pos[3 * i + 1];\n        zi = pos[3 * i + 2];\n    }\n\n    double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;\n\n    for (int tile = 0; tile < n; tile += BLOCK_SIZE) {\n        const int j = tile + threadIdx.x;\n        if (j < n) {\n            tileX[threadIdx.x] = pos[3 * j + 0];\n            tileY[threadIdx.x] = pos[3 * j + 1];\n            tileZ[threadIdx.x] = pos[3 * j + 2];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        if (active) {\n            const int limit = min(BLOCK_SIZE, n - tile);\n#pragma unroll 4\n            for (int k = 0; k < limit; ++k) {\n                const double dx = tileX[k] - xi;\n                const double dy = tileY[k] - yi;\n                const double dz = tileZ[k] - zi;\n                const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n                const double invDist = 1.0 / sqrt(distSqr);\n                const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n\n                Fx += dx * invDist3;\n                Fy += dy * invDist3;\n                Fz += dz * invDist3;\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (active) {\n        vel[3 * local + 0] += DT * Fx;\n        vel[3 * local + 1] += DT * Fy;\n        vel[3 * local + 2] += DT * Fz;\n    }\n}\n\n// Advances the owned positions. Runs as a separate launch so that every force\n// evaluation in a step reads the positions from before any body moves.\n__global__ void integrateKernel(double* __restrict__ pos, const double* __restrict__ vel,\n                                const int firstBody, const int count) {\n    const int local = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (local >= count) {\n        return;\n    }\n    const int i = firstBody + local;\n    pos[3 * i + 0] += vel[3 * local + 0] * DT;\n    pos[3 * i + 1] += vel[3 * local + 1] * DT;\n    pos[3 * i + 2] += vel[3 * local + 2] * DT;\n}\n\ndouble computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    double energy = 0.0;\n    const size_t n = bodies.size();\n\n    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)\n    for (const auto& body : bodies) {\n        energy += 0.5 * (body.vel.x * body.vel.x +\n                        body.vel.y * body.vel.y +\n                        body.vel.z * body.vel.z);\n    }\n\n    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies), summed across OpenMP threads\n    double potential = 0.0;\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 16) reduction(+ : potential)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = bodies[j].pos.x - bodies[i].pos.x;\n            const double dy = bodies[j].pos.y - bodies[i].pos.y;\n            const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;\n            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);\n            potential += 1.0 / dist;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return energy - potential;\n}\n\n// Validate that simulation produces finite, reasonable values\nbool validateSimulation(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    for (const auto& body : bodies) {\n        // Check for NaN or Inf values\n        if (!std::isfinite(body.pos.x) || !std::isfinite(body.pos.y) || !std::isfinite(body.pos.z) ||\n            !std::isfinite(body.vel.x) || !std::isfinite(body.vel.y) || !std::isfinite(body.vel.z)) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value in body state\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Check for extreme values (bodies shouldn't fly off to infinity)\n        const double maxPos = 1e6;\n        const double maxVel = 1e6;\n        if (std::abs(body.pos.x) > maxPos || std::abs(body.pos.y) > maxPos || std::abs(body.pos.z) > maxPos) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n        if (std::abs(body.vel.x) > maxVel || std::abs(body.vel.y) > maxVel || std::abs(body.vel.z) > maxVel) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of bodies (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Number of simulation steps (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation (checks energy conservation)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\n// Runs the simulation on every MPI rank. Bodies are block-distributed across ranks;\n// each rank computes forces for its own bodies on its GPU and the updated positions\n// are exchanged with MPI_Allgatherv after every step. Rank 0 reports results.\nint runSimulation(const int numBodies, const int numSteps, const bool validate, const bool printResults) {\n    int rank = 0, size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n\n    const int n = numBodies;\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"N-Body Simulation\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of bodies: %d\\n\", numBodies);\n        printf(\"Number of steps: %d\\n\", numSteps);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    // Block distribution of bodies across ranks (the first n % size ranks get one extra)\n    std::vector<int> counts3(size), displs3(size);\n    for (int r = 0, offset = 0; r < size; ++r) {\n        const int count = n / size + (r < n % size ? 1 : 0);\n        counts3[r] = 3 * count;\n        displs3[r] = 3 * offset;\n        offset += count;\n    }\n    const int first = displs3[rank] / 3;\n    const int count = counts3[rank] / 3;\n\n    // Bind each local rank to its own GPU\n    MPI_Comm localComm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &localComm);\n    int localRank = 0;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(localComm, &localRank);\n    MPI_Comm_free(&localComm);\n    int deviceCount = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(localRank % deviceCount));\n\n    // Initialize bodies (identical on every rank, since the seed is fixed)\n    std::vector<Body> bodies(n);\n    randomizeBodies(bodies);\n\n    // Pinned host staging buffers for fast transfers. Positions are the full array\n    // (kept in sync across ranks); velocities are only needed for owned bodies until the end.\n    const size_t posLen = std::max<size_t>(3 * (size_t)n, 1);\n    double* hPos = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hPos, posLen * sizeof(double)));\n    std::vector<double> hVel(posLen);\n\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        hPos[3 * i + 0] = bodies[i].pos.x;\n        hPos[3 * i + 1] = bodies[i].pos.y;\n        hPos[3 * i + 2] = bodies[i].pos.z;\n        hVel[3 * i + 0] = bodies[i].vel.x;\n        hVel[3 * i + 1] = bodies[i].vel.y;\n        hVel[3 * i + 2] = bodies[i].vel.z;\n    }\n\n    double* dPos = nullptr;\n    double* dVel = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dPos, posLen * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dVel, std::max<size_t>(3 * (size_t)count, 1) * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dPos, hPos, posLen * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dVel, hVel.data() + 3 * (size_t)first,\n                          3 * (size_t)count * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    const int numBlocks = (count + BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / BLOCK_SIZE;\n\n    // Run simulation\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    for (int step = 0; step < numSteps; ++step) {\n        if (count > 0) {\n            computeForcesKernel<<<numBlocks, BLOCK_SIZE>>>(dPos, dVel, n, first, count);\n            integrateKernel<<<numBlocks, BLOCK_SIZE>>>(dPos, dVel, first, count);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        }\n\n        // Share the updated positions of owned bodies with all ranks\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hPos + 3 * (size_t)first, dPos + 3 * (size_t)first,\n                              3 * (size_t)count * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, hPos, counts3.data(), k < limit; ++k) {\n                const double dx = tileX[k] - xi;\n                const double dy = tileY[k] - yi;\n                const double dz = tileZ[k] - zi;\n                const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n                const double invDist = 1.0 / sqrt(distSqr);\n                const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n\n                Fx += dx * invDist3;\n                Fy += dy * invDist3;\n                Fz += dz * invDist3;\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (active) {\n        vel[3 * local + 0] += DT * Fx;\n        vel[3 * local + 1] += DT * Fy;\n        vel[3 * local + 2] += DT * Fz;\n    }\n}\n\n// Advances the owned positions.                                            \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                                 \\\n        }                                                                                 \\\n    } while (0)\n\nvoid randomizeBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    for (auto& body : bodies) {\n        body.pos.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Force phase for the locally owned bodies [firstBody, firstBody + count).\n// Each body's accumulation runs over all j in ascending order, exactly as the\n// serial reference does, so results are bit-identical. A thread owns BODIES_PER_THREAD\n// bodies; their accumulation chains are independent, which hides FP64 latency when\n// there are few bodies per GPU. Tiles of positions are staged in shared memory so\n// each load is reused by every body in the block.\ntemplate <int BLOCK, int BODIES_PER_THREAD>\n__global__ void computeForcesKernel(const double* __restrict__ pos, double* __restrict__ vel,\n                                    const int n, const int firstBody, const int count) {\n    __shared__ double tileX[BLOCK];\n    __shared__ double tileY[BLOCK];\n    __shared__ double tileZ[BLOCK];\n\n    double xi[BODIES_PER_THREAD], yi[BODIES_PER_THREAD], zi[BODIES_PER_THREAD];\n    double Fx[BODIES_PER_THREAD], Fy[BODIES_PER_THREAD], Fz[BODIES_PER_THREAD];\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int b = 0; b < BODIES_PER_THREAD; ++b) {\n        const int local = blockIdx.x * (BLOCK * BODIES_PER_THREAD) + b * BLOCK + threadIdx.x;\n        const int i = firstBody + min(local, count - 1);\n        xi[b] = pos[3 * i + 0];\n        yi[b] = pos[3 * i + 1];\n        zi[b] = pos[3 * i + 2];\n        Fx[b] = 0.0;\n        Fy[b] = 0.0;\n        Fz[b] = 0.0;\n    }\n\n    for (int tile = 0; tile < n; tile += BLOCK) {\n        const int j = tile + threadIdx.x;\n        if (j < n) {\n            tileX[threadIdx.x] = pos[3 * j + 0];\n            tileY[threadIdx.x] = pos[3 * j + 1];\n            tileZ[threadIdx.x] = pos[3 * j + 2];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        const int limit = min(BLOCK, n - tile);\n        for (int k = 0; k < limit; ++k) {\n            const double tx = tileX[k];\n            const double ty = tileY[k];\n            const double tz = tileZ[k];\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int b = 0; b < BODIES_PER_THREAD; ++b) {\n                const double dx = tx - xi[b];\n                const double dy = ty - yi[b];\n                const double dz = tz - zi[b];\n                const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n                const double invDist = 1.0 / sqrt(distSqr);\n                const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n\n                Fx[b] += dx * invDist3;\n                Fy[b] += dy * invDist3;\n                Fz[b] += dz * invDist3;\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int b = 0; b < BODIES_PER_THREAD; ++b) {\n        const int local = blockIdx.x * (BLOCK * BODIES_PER_THREAD) + b * BLOCK + threadIdx.x;\n        if (local < count) {\n            vel[3 * local + 0] += DT * Fx[b];\n            vel[3 * local + 1] += DT * Fy[b];\n            vel[3 * local + 2] += DT * Fz[b];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Advances the owned positions. Runs as a separate launch so that every force\n// evaluation in a step reads the positions from before any body moves.\n__global__ void integrateKernel(double* __restrict__ pos, const double* __restrict__ vel,\n                                const int firstBody, const int count) {\n    const int local = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (local >= count) {\n        return;\n    }\n    const int i = firstBody + local;\n    pos[3 * i + 0] += vel[3 * local + 0] * DT;\n    pos[3 * i + 1] += vel[3 * local + 1] * DT;\n    pos[3 * i + 2] += vel[3 * local + 2] * DT;\n}\n\ndouble computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    double energy = 0.0;\n    const size_t n = bodies.size();\n\n    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)\n    for (const auto& body : bodies) {\n        energy += 0.5 * (body.vel.x * body.vel.x +\n                        body.vel.y * body.vel.y +\n                        body.vel.z * body.vel.z);\n    }\n\n    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies), summed across OpenMP threads\n    double potential = 0.0;\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 16) reduction(+ : potential)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = bodies[j].pos.x - bodies[i].pos.x;\n            const double dy = bodies[j].pos.y - bodies[i].pos.y;\n            const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;\n            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);\n            potential += 1.0 / dist;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return energy - potential;\n}\n\n// Validate that simulation produces finite, reasonable values\nbool validateSimulation(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    for (const auto& body : bodies) {\n        // Check for NaN or Inf values\n        if (!std::isfinite(body.pos.x) || !std::isfinite(body.pos.y) || !std::isfinite(body.pos.z) ||\n            !std::isfinite(body.vel.x) || !std::isfinite(body.vel.y) || !std::isfinite(body.vel.z)) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value in body state\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Check for extreme values (bodies shouldn't fly off to infinity)\n        const double maxPos = 1e6;\n        const double maxVel = 1e6;\n        if (std::abs(body.pos.x) > maxPos || std::abs(body.pos.y) > maxPos || std::abs(body.pos.z) > maxPos) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n        if (std::abs(body.vel.x) > maxVel || std::abs(body.vel.y) > maxVel || std::abs(body.vel.z) > maxVel) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of bodies (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Number of simulation steps (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation (checks energy conservation)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\n// Runs the simulation on every MPI rank. Bodies are block-distributed across ranks;\n// each rank computes forces for its own bodies on its GPU and the updated positions\n// are exchanged with MPI_Allgatherv after every step. Rank 0 reports results.\nint runSimulation(const int numBodies, const int numSteps, const bool validate, const bool printResults) {\n    int rank = 0, size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n\n    const int n = numBodies;\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"N-Body Simulation\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of bodies: %d\\n\", numBodies);\n        printf(\"Number of steps: %d\\n\", numSteps);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    // Block distribution of bodies across ranks (the first n % size ranks get one extra)\n    std::vector<int> counts3(size), displs3(size);\n    for (int r = 0, offset = 0; r < size; ++r) {\n        const int count = n / size + (r < n % size ? 1 : 0);\n        counts3[r] = 3 * count;\n        displs3[r] = 3 * offset;\n        offset += count;\n    }\n    const int first = displs3[rank] / 3;\n    const int count = counts3[rank] / 3;\n\n    // Bind each local rank to its own GPU\n    MPI_Comm localComm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &localComm);\n    int localRank = 0;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(localComm, &localRank);\n    MPI_Comm_free(&localComm);\n    int deviceCount = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(localRank % deviceCount));\n\n    // Initialize bodies (identical on every rank, since the seed is fixed)\n    std::vector<Body> bodies(n);\n    randomizeBodies(bodies);\n\n    // Pinned host staging buffers for fast transfers. Positions are the full array\n    // (kept in sync across ranks); velocities are only needed for owned bodies until the end.\n    const size_t posLen = std::max<size_t>(3 * (size_t)n, 1);\n    double* hPos = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hPos, posLen * sizeof(double)));\n    std::vector<double> hVel(posLen);\n\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        hPos[3 * i + 0] = bodies[i].pos.x;\n        hPos[3 * i + 1] = bodies[i].pos.y;\n        hPos[3 * i + 2] = bodies[i].pos.z;\n        hVel[3 * i + 0] = bodies[i].vel.x;\n        hVel[3 * i + 1] = bodies[i].vel.y;\n        hVel[3 * i + 2] = bodies[i].vel.z;\n    }\n\n    double* dPos = nullptr;\n    double* dVel = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dPos, posLen * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dVel, std::max<size_t>(3 * (size_t)count, 1) * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dPos, hPos, posLen * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dVel, hVel.data() + 3 * (size_t)first,\n                          3 * (size_t)count * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    const int forceBlocks = (count + FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE * FORCE_BODIES_PER_THREAD - 1) /\n                            (FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE * FORCE_BODIES_PER_THREAD);\n    const int integrateBlocks = (count + INTEGRATE_BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / INTEGRATE_BLOCK_SIZE;\n\n    // Run simulation\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    for (int step = 0; step < numSteps; ++step) {\n        if (count > 0) {\n            computeForcesKernel<FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE, FORCE_BODIES_PER_THREAD>\n                <<<forceBlocks, FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(dPos, dVel, n, first, count);\n            integrateKernel<<<integrateBlocks, INTEGRATE_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(dPos, dVel, first, count);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        }\n\n        // Share the updated positions of owned bodies with all ranks\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hPos + 3 * (size_t)first, dPos + 3 * (size_t)first,\n                              3 * (size_t)count * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, hPos, counts3.data(), displs3.data(),\n                       MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        // Refresh the device copy of bodies owned by other ranks (owned slice is already current)\n        if (first > 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dPos, hPos, 3 * (size_t)first * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        }\n        if (first + count < n) {\n            const size_t tail = 3 * (size_t)(first + count);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dPos + tail, hPos + tail, (3 * (size_t)n - tail) * sizeof(double),\n {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfxrGFg1VkagPe4EwmRxK","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA version is in place. Only `nbody/nbody.cpp` and `nbody/CMakeLists.txt` changed, the executable is still `nbody`, and no files were created.\n\n**Design**\n- **MPI:** bodies are block-distributed across ranks. Each rank computes forces for its own bodies, then `MPI_Allgatherv` shares the updated positions every step. Each rank binds to a GPU by its node-local rank.\n- **CUDA:** a tiled shared-memory force kernel and a separate integrate kernel. The integrate kernel runs as its own launch so every force evaluation in a step reads pre-update positions.\n- **OpenMP:** the O(N²) potential-energy reduction (`-v` only) and host-side data packing.\n- **Build:** `find_package` for MPI, OpenMP, and CUDAToolkit, all `REQUIRED`. Since no `.cu` file is allowed, `nbody.cpp` is compiled as a CUDA source with `-Xcompiler` passing the host flags. Architectures default to 75/80/86/90 and can be overridden. `cmake_minimum_required` is now 3.24.\n\n**Verification** (4× RTX 3090 here, MPI, nvcc 12.0)\n- Hashes match the original built with `-ffp-contract=off` for N=4096, 5000, 1000, 1025, 257, 3, 1 across 1–4 ranks, including uneven splits and ranks with zero bodies. The results are bit-identical across rank counts.\n- N=0 runs and `-v` validation pass. `-h` and unknown-option paths behave as before.\n\n**Performance**\n- N=4096, 10 steps: original 1239 ms (CPU), new 56 ms on 4 GPUs.\n- N=32768, 10 steps: 1 GPU 1502 ms, 2 GPUs 784 ms, 4 GPUs 399 ms.\n- N=65536, 3 steps, 4 GPUs: 469 ms.\n- I tried giving each thread several bodies to add instruction-level parallelism. It was slower (780 ms vs 410 ms on 4 GPUs), so I kept one body per thread with a block size of 128.\n\n**Deviations to be aware of**\n1. **Default-build hash differs.** The original's default build (`-march=native`) lets GCC fuse multiply-adds, giving hash `e871a7b8b5caf3a3`. The new code uses strict IEEE semantics on both host and device, matching the original built with `-ffp-contract=off` (`d0d62960bc3fc285`). Results differ by about 1e-12 relative. If you want to match the default-build hash exactly, I can allow contraction on the device, but I'd expect it to only match by luck.\n2. **Energy last digits.** The `-v` \"Final energy\" can differ in the last few digits because OpenMP reorders the potential-energy sum. It's still printed to 6 decimals.\n3. **Negative `-n`** now prints an error and exits 1. The original crashed with an exception.\n4. **No CPU fallback.** Every rank needs a GPU, as you asked.\n\n**Not done**\n- MPI is not CUDA-aware, so positions are staged through pinned host memory.\n- Communication and computation are not overlapped.\n- On the 3090, FP64 runs at 1/64 rate, so these numbers are bounded by FP64 throughput; data-center GPUs with full-rate FP64 should do much better.\n\nI did not commit anything."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":888,"cache_read_input_tokens":81833,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":888},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"c7fb4b18-40b3-417e-8842-b66313a129dc","uuid":"6c1bb26b-f14d-4028-a997-b90d106a8162","timestamp":"2026-10-12T18:54:16.737Z","request_id":"req_011CfxrGF345oiMkeL2uQYSf"}
